QBF data distribution source

Mark Peyrer, Maximilian Heisinger and Martina Seidl (2026).
Artifact for ParaProofa: A Certifying Parallel Cube-and-Conquer QBF-Solving
Framework, v1. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18832723.
The dataset record uses CC BY 4.0. Retain its creators, title, permanent
link and license. Original QBF family contributors remain credited in
qbf-original-source-review.json.

Three selected BMC instances retain the University of Toronto 2007
noncommercial education/research permission and disclaimer in
QBF-BMC-Toronto-research.txt; the general dataset record does not remove
these known original conditions.

Changes to 57 selected inputs: block-preserving variable bijections,
literal/clause reordering and comment removal. The original source and
output hashes are recorded in qbf-data-distribution-source.json. Original
notices must accompany the transformed files. No mathematical statement,
instance membership, solver, checker, score or reference value changed
in this documentation work.

The source archive's root MIT notice covers its software/documentation;
it is retained separately. No grant for unrelated programs in that
archive is inferred from the dataset's CC BY label.
